model: RBC-BP2 Black Pear II BMS interface
equipment_type: VRF / split AC BACnet IP gateway
applies_to: Toshiba VRF and split indoor units on the U3/U4 TCC-Link network, up to 64 unit addresses per Black Pear II.
summary: The Black Pear II (RBC-BP2) is a BMS interface with a touch screen that connects to the Toshiba TCC-Link (U3/U4) network and serves up to 64 indoor unit addresses over BACnet IP, Modbus RTU/TCP or Trend. Each unit address gets the same block of setup (_w) and state (_r) objects named after the unit name set in the Black Pear, plus two system objects. BACnet is off by default and has to be enabled in the protocol settings.
notes: Per-unit instance = 1xxxPP: xxx = unit address 001-064, PP = point 01-22. Instances here use unit 001 (e.g. 100101); object names start with the configured unit name (nnn).
Points 1xxx15, 1xxx16 and 1xxx20-1xxx22 are listed as unused. 1xxx17 is an Analog Input marked {HVAC Specific} with no object name and is left out.
The object name for 1xxx11 is printed as 'nnn (LI_w' with the closing bracket missing.
Only the group master address accepts commands; other units in a group report the master's status, apart from return air temperature and error code.
Setting the setpoint to one decimal place only works if the indoor unit accepts that resolution.

source.title: Black Pear II Display Controller v1_00 Installation & Owners Manual (RBC-BP2)

integration.summary: Enable BACnet in the Black Pear protocol settings, set the device ID and unit names, group the units, then map each group master's _w (command) and _r (state) objects. Wait for Sys_HVAC_Network_Status = Ready before sending commands.

minimum_points.name: nnn (FS_w)
minimum_points.why: Fan speed: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 auto

minimum_points.name: Sys_HVAC_Network_Status
minimum_points.why: Gateway link status; commands work only when Ready

integration.enable: No enable point is needed per unit; only the group master address accepts commands. The digital input is a normally-closed volt-free Global Forced Off contact: opening it switches all fan coils off and inhibits their remotes (refreshed every 10 s). Sys_Force_Off (BV 100024) is the BACnet global off; Global-Off can be enabled or disabled per group.
integration.heartbeat: No BMS heartbeat. Sys_HVAC_Network_Status reads Waiting/Searching after a restart; commands sent before it reads Ready are ignored.
setup: Factory defaults: BACnet disabled, device ID 200, UDP port 47808, IP 192.168.1.20, mask 255.255.255.0, DHCP off.
Foreign device registration is off by default (BBMD 192.168.1.22, TTL 1800 s when enabled).
Device ID, device name and object names (unit names) are set from the touch screen or the built-in web pages.
Connect to outdoor unit terminals U3/U4 like a central controller; each indoor unit needs a network address 1-64.
gotchas: Writes to non-master units in a group have no effect.
No segmentation and a 480-octet maximum APDU; keep ReadPropertyMultiple requests short.
Units grouped on the remote-controller wiring (AB) share one address, so follower status is not available.
Up to 256 COV subscriptions are supported.

points.name: nnn (ECode)
points.description: 4-digit error code (8000 = no error, 6999 = unit not present)

points.name: nnn (MD_w)
points.description: Operation mode command (7-8 not settable, 9-11 VN units)

points.name: Sys_HVAC_Network_Status
points.description: Link status to the TCC-Link network; commands ignored until Ready
